title: fix RFC 6265 cookie parsing for browser control surface
description: Updated session_cookie in src/web/mod.rs to iterate all Cookie headers and unquote/trim session token values according to RFC 6265.
impact: Prevents session authentication failures or cookie extraction bypass when browsers or proxies send multiple Cookie headers or quoted cookie values.

title: fix constant-time PIN comparison logic
description: replaced short-circuiting boolean AND operations with subtle::Choice constant-time bitwise combination
impact: prevents potential timing side-channel leaks during PIN authentication length validation

title: replace unwrap with expect context
description: Replaced unwrap() with expect() context in pairing test to adhere to Rust coding guidelines
impact: Improves test error context and code standard compliance

title: remove expect from proxy frame flag helpers
description: replaced FrameFlags::from_bits(...).expect(...) with direct BitOr operations to prevent potential panic in production code per STYLE.md rules
impact: eliminates potential panic path during proxy frame flag construction

title: redact bootstrap token in BrowserControlConfig Debug formatting
description: Implemented custom Debug for BrowserControlConfig to prevent leaking sensitive bootstrap_token in log messages or debug traces
impact: Prevents unauthorized disclosure of bearer tokens in application log files and debug outputs

title: redact sensitive CSRF and access tokens in proxy headers
description: Added x-csrf-token, x-xsrf-token, and x-access-token to is_sensitive_header in proxy policy module to prevent sensitive token disclosure in proxy logs and transcripts
impact: Prevents disclosure of CSRF and API access tokens in proxy logging or error reports

title: redact PIN secrets in SessionRuntimeConfig Debug formatting
description: Implemented custom Debug for SessionRuntimeConfig to prevent leaking sensitive expected_pin and auth_pins in log messages or debug traces
impact: Prevents unauthorized disclosure of authentication PINs in application log files and debug traces

title: prevent null byte injection in file paths
description: Enforced null byte rejection in FileTransferService's path resolution helper to prevent path truncation or null byte injection vulnerabilities.
impact: Mitigates potential null byte injection/path truncation vulnerabilities in file transfer request paths.

title: redact sensitive pin in Config Debug output
description: Implemented custom Debug for Config to prevent leaking sensitive pin in log messages or debug traces
impact: Prevents unauthorized disclosure of PIN credentials in application log files and debug outputs

title: redact TURN credential in IceServer Debug formatting
description: Implemented custom Debug for IceServer to prevent leaking sensitive TURN credentials in log messages or debug traces
impact: Prevents unauthorized disclosure of TURN credentials in application log files and debug outputs

title: add X-Frame-Options and Content-Security-Policy headers
description: Added X-Frame-Options: DENY and Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none' security headers to the browser control surface middleware to prevent clickjacking and framing attacks.
impact: Protects the loopback browser surface from clickjacking and unauthorized frame embedding.

title: validate peer id input from udp discovery packets
description: Added input validation for peer IDs received over untrusted local discovery UDP multicast packets to reject malformed, oversized, or control character strings.
impact: Prevents terminal control sequence injection, log injection, and memory bounds issues from spoofed mDNS/UDP discovery packets on local networks.

title: redact PIN in AuthMessage Debug formatting
description: Implemented custom Debug for AuthMessage to redact sensitive pin field in log messages or debug traces per STYLE.md rules
impact: Prevents unauthorized disclosure of session authentication PINs in application log files and debug outputs
